response.original_title: The Orb: History Of The Future Part 2
response.overview: The DVD included in The Orb’s 4-disc box set History of the Future Part 2 (released February 20, 2015) features rare audiovisual material from Alex Paterson's post-major-label era (moving past the 90s Island Records days into the 21st century with independent labels, soundscapes, and collaborations), including the 17-minute Battersea Bunches short film and additional bonus audio/visual content.
